channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Festus Ezeli | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Festus Ezeli from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Festus Ezeli
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Festus Ezeli trying to make an NBA comeback:

“I love Festus. I love his zest for life, his desire to play. I sure hope it happens for him. It's such a shame when a guy so young suffers from injuries that keep him from playing.”

Steve Kerr on Festus Ezeli, Jan 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Bob Myers on Harrison Barnes, Festus Ezeli
item.description:
“I know we’re all measured in those (NBA Finals) moments, but both of those guys (Harrison Barnes and Festus Ezeli) have been great for us and have helped us get where we are,”

Bob Myers on Harrison Barnes, Festus Ezeli, Jun 22, 2016. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Peter Guber on Leandro Barbosa, Andrew Bogut, Nemanja Nedovic, Festus Ezeli, Ognjen Kuzmic
item.description:
“The following is a great example of the growth of our league. There are 101 international players on NBA opening night rosters, which represents 22% of the league. We have five [5] international players on our roster (33%), which includes Andrew Bogut, Leandro Barbosa, Festus Ezeli, Ognjen Kuzmic and Nemanja Nedovic. We've come a long way…”

Peter Guber on Leandro Barbosa, Andrew Bogut, Nemanja Nedovic, Festus Ezeli, Ognjen Kuzmic, Oct 28, 2014. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Al Horford on Jeff Teague, Doron Lamb, Marquis Teague, Festus Ezeli
item.description:
Al Horford:

“We have the 23rd pick and I know the team will draft the best player available. I would like to pick a shooter like Kentucky's Doron Lamb. But it wouldn't bother me if they picked a big who could help me like Festus Ezeli(Vanderbilt). Anyway, I doubt they will pick Jeff Teague's brother, Marquis Teague.”

Al Horford on Jeff Teague, Doron Lamb, Marquis Teague, Festus Ezeli, Jun 21, 2012. Source: Primera Hora.
